description:
You are the Scrum Master for the Mobile Application v2 team at DevLabs. The v2.0 Release sprint has ended. You need to perform the end-of-sprint closeout.

Complete the following sprint closeout actions:

1. The 'Dark mode: tab bar icons inverted on Android 12 (Material You)' issue is in the 'v1.9 Legacy' milestone and has status 'Resolved'. Fully close it: change its status to 'Closed'.

2. The 'Offline mode: local changes lost on sync conflict' issue (v2.0 Release milestone, Urgent priority) has been deemed too risky to ship in v2.0 without further testing. Move it from the 'v2.0 Release' milestone to the 'v2.1 Hotfix' milestone. Add a comment: 'Deferred from v2.0 Release: too risky to ship without comprehensive regression testing. Carrying forward to v2.1 Hotfix milestone.'

3. The 'Push notifications not delivered when app is force-closed on iOS' issue (v2.0 Release, In Progress) has been fixed and tested this sprint. Log 1.5 hours of Testing activity on this issue — the log entry should show grace.lee as the user (log it from her account or note her as the person who did the testing) with comment: 'Sprint review: verified push notification fix on iOS 16.4 and 17.2 devices. Fix confirmed working.' Then change its status from 'In Progress' to 'Resolved'.

4. Create a new Feature issue in the Mobile Application v2 project to document the closeout:
   - Subject: 'v2.0 Release sprint closeout complete'
   - Priority: Low
   - Status: Closed
   - Assigned to: alice.chen
   - Target version: v2.0 Release
   - Description: 'Sprint closeout actions complete. Push notification fix verified and resolved by grace.lee. Offline sync conflict deferred to v2.1 Hotfix milestone. Team ready for v2.0 launch pending final sign-off.'

Login credentials: admin / Admin1234!
